name: Salt-Touched
description: The district has marked you. You taste salt in unexpected places. The world notices you more clearly.

name: Wounded
description: Your blood is not the right color. It carries something that flickers in the lamplight.

name: Exhausted
description: Every closed eye contains a street you have not walked yet. Rest does not come cleanly.

name: Haunted by Bells
description: You hear bells at unexpected moments. They ring from inside your skull, from a place that remembers being a church.

name: Too Remembered
description: The fountain knows your true name. The world uses it when it thinks you are not listening.

name: Debt-Marked
description: The debt court has added your name to a list. They will hear from you when your debts mature.
